name: Gene's Electronics
old_description: Special Offers for Seniors, Military and many front-line workers
about:
Gene's Electronics operates as an authorized DISH retailer from its location at 62 West Main Street in Fort Kent, Maine. The company provides satellite television and broadband internet services to residents across the region, serving as a local point of sale and support for both product lines.

The business sells DISH programming packages—including America's Top 120, Top 200, and Top 250—bundled with the Hopper 3 whole-home DVR system. It also offers Starlink high-speed satellite internet plans. Services include free standard professional installation and 24/7 customer support. The Hopper 3 unit provides features such as automatic commercial skipping, multi-view recording, and up to 2,000 hours of storage.

Primary customers are residential households in rural and underserved areas, with specific promotions advertised for seniors, military personnel, and front-line workers. The company emphasizes its local presence and commitment to keeping communities connected through reliable signal delivery and a money-back guarantee on service reliability.

Gene's Electronics differentiates itself through consistent, reliable local service and a two-year price guarantee on DISH packages, positioning itself as a convenient alternative to national call centers. The shop also highlights the ability to switch TV packages anytime and includes local channels in every plan.
